challenge.en: Keeping source audio separate from transcript edits in an Android speech-to-text prototype.
challenge.zh-TW: 在 Android 語音轉文字原型中，將來源音訊與逐字稿修改分開保存。

solution.en: The prototype stores source audio separately from transcript edits and offers cleanup suggestions for review.
solution.zh-TW: 原型將來源音訊與逐字稿修改分開保存，並提供可供檢視的清理建議。

boundary.en: Separates raw immutable audio from reviewable transcript cleanup under on-device processing.
boundary.zh-TW: 於裝置端處理流程中，嚴格隔離原始不可變音訊與可檢視之逐字稿建議。

aInput.en: Keeping source audio available while reviewing speech-to-text edits
aInput.zh-TW: 檢視語音辨識文字時，仍保留來源音訊的目標

weakestLink.en: Separating source audio from transcript changes in the Android prototype
weakestLink.zh-TW: 在 Android 原型中區分來源音訊與逐字稿修改

bOutput.en: Source-audio retention goal with reviewable transcript cleanup in an Android prototype
bOutput.zh-TW: Android 原型以保留來源音訊為目標，並讓逐字稿清理可供檢視

strictInvariant.en: The implementation saves and checks source audio before ASR; transcript cleanup changes text, not the audio file.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: 實作會先保存並檢查來源音訊，再執行 ASR；逐字稿清理修改文字，不改動音訊檔。

en: Claims of zero loss under process termination
Claims of legal, executive, or medical workflow compliance
zh-TW: 宣稱在程序終止時也能保證零資料遺失
宣稱符合法律、高階商務或醫療工作流程規範
未經檢視的自動文字覆寫

failureConditions.en: Capture evidence that fails validation leaves the take incomplete and blocked from ASR dispatch.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 擷取證據未通過檢查時，錄音會維持未完成並禁止 ASR 派發。

challenger.en: How does the prototype keep source audio separate from text cleanup?
challenger.zh-TW: 原型如何將來源音訊與文字清理分開？

defense.en: The Android prototype stores source audio separately from transcript text. Its rule-based cleanup offers selected spans for review; it does not use an LLM cleanup pass.
defense.zh-TW: Android 原型將來源音訊與逐字稿分開保存。規則式清理會提出可檢視的文字片段，不使用 LLM 改寫逐字稿。

challenger.en: How does the system ensure privacy on mobile devices?
challenger.zh-TW: 該系統如何在行動裝置端確保使用者隱私？

defense.en: The current code uses app-private no-backup storage and on-device Whisper. Pixel/OEM backup and device-transfer behavior has not been verified.
defense.zh-TW: 目前程式使用 app-private no-backup 儲存與裝置端 Whisper；Pixel／OEM 備份與裝置移轉行為尚未驗證。

staff.en: Android prototype for source-audio storage and transcript review
staff.zh-TW: Android 原型：來源音訊保存與逐字稿檢視

coreQuestion.en: How can the prototype separate source audio from transcript changes and expose incomplete captures?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 原型如何區分來源音訊與逐字稿修改，並標示未完成的錄音？

breakthrough.en: The code stores source audio separately from transcript data and applies cleanup only to accepted text spans. Device capture and recovery need separate evidence.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 程式將來源音訊與逐字稿資料分開保存，只對接受的文字片段套用清理；裝置擷取與復原仍需獨立證據。

verifiedMoat.en: Synthetic save/review paths are tested; physical microphone completeness and process-restart acceptance remain open.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 已測試合成儲存與檢視流程；實體麥克風擷取完整性與程序重啟驗收仍未完成。

em.en: Personal Android prototype for source audio and reviewed transcript edits
em.zh-TW: 個人 Android 原型：來源音訊與逐字稿修改檢視

coreQuestion.en: What does the prototype support about source storage and transcript edits?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 原型在來源音訊保存與逐字稿修改方面有哪些可支持的結果？

breakthrough.en: Built local source-audio, transcript-review, and user-accepted cleanup paths for a personal prototype.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 為個人原型建立本機來源音訊、逐字稿檢視與使用者接受後才套用的清理流程。

verifiedMoat.en: Recorded evidence covers selected synthetic flows; no customer-adoption or revision-efficiency result is supported.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 紀錄涵蓋部分合成流程；沒有證據支持客戶採用或修訂效率成果。

recruiter.en: On-device speech prototype · Source-audio boundary · User-reviewed edits
recruiter.zh-TW: 裝置端語音原型 · 來源音訊界線 · 使用者檢視修改

coreQuestion.en: Which privacy and domain-use claims can the prototype support?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 原型能支持哪些隱私與領域使用主張？

breakthrough.en: The prototype uses local storage and on-device ASR. Backup transfer and legal, medical, or enterprise suitability have not been assessed.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 原型使用本機儲存與裝置端 ASR；備份移轉，以及法律、醫療或企業用途適用性均未評估。

verifiedMoat.en: No legal, medical, or enterprise workflow validation is claimed.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 不宣稱已通過法律、醫療或企業工作流程驗證。

en.summary: An Android prototype stores source audio separately and lets users review transcript cleanup suggestions.
en.boundary: On-device Android architecture prioritizing immutable audio integrity and non-destructive transcript cleanup.

zh-TW.summary: Android 原型將來源音訊與逐字稿修改分開保存，並讓使用者檢視清理建議。
zh-TW.evidence: 個人專案 · Android 原型
zh-TW.boundary: Android 裝置端架構，以來源音訊不可變性與無損逐字稿清理為核心規範。
zh-TW.action: 查看錄音到文字的流程
